bool belowZero(List<int> operations) {
  int current = 0;
  for (int op in operations) {
    if (op < 0 && -op > current) return true;
    current += op;
  }
  return false;

import 'dart:math';

List<double> rescaleToUnit(List<double> numbers) {
  if (numbers.isEmpty) return [];
  
  double min = numbers.reduce(min);
  double max = numbers.reduce(max);
  double range = max - min;
  
  if (range == 0.0) {
    // All values are the same, so return a list of zeros or ones?
    // Returning all zeros as per common practice when scaling to unit interval.
    return List.filled(numbers.length, 0.0);
  }
  
  return numbers.map((num) => (num - min) / range).toList();
}

List<int> sortArray(List<int> arr) {
  if (arr == null || arr.isEmpty) return [];

  int n = arr.length;
  for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    for (int j = 0; j < n - i - 1; j++) {
      if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1]) {
        int temp = arr[j];
        arr[j] = arr[j + 1];
        arr[j + 1] = temp;
      }
    }
  }

  return arr;
}
